traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: The priest is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 15, +7 to hit with spell attacks). It has the following cleric spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): light, mending, sacred flame, spare the dying * 1st level (4 slots): divine favor, guiding bolt, healing word, shield of faith * 2nd level (3 slots): lesser restoration, magic weapon, prayer of healing, silence, spiritual weapon * 3rd level (3 slots): beacon of hope, crusader's mantle, dispel magic, revivify, spirit guardians, water wall * 4th level (3 slots): banishment, freedom of movement, guardian of faith, stoneskin * 5th level (1 slot): flame strike, mass cure wounds, hold monster

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The priest makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Maul
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 +3) bludgeoning damage.
